answer: What if the stage tied every mask to one trellis, and the trellis fell as one? Each identity stakes a bond woven into the same lattice; when masks cheat in chorus in a single epoch, every bond burns together — ten masks, ten bonds, yet the forfeit is squared, a hundredfold loss for a tenfold fraud. A willow stands by bending alone; no forest of clones can bend the voyage of honest play. One player, one mask, one honest part.
